hypothesis: A TRAIN-learned, proof-checked live-binding quotient representation can compose persistent shared-role operators while forgetting only bindings no longer live in the remaining word, and may lower complete query+CPU+RSS cost on unfamiliar S3 causal structures relative to fully trained T16B and exact symbolic controls, without a single wrong answer.

falsifiable_mechanism.novelty: Replace the assignment-enumeration search state by an exact quotient transducer keyed by (word_position, partial_output, still_live_shared_role_bindings). Merge states only when these keys are exactly equal and the same future continuations are proven possible.
falsifiable_mechanism.guaranteed_safety: Any dropped binding must have no further occurrence in the reduced word; the quotient is audited against exhaustive exact semantics on all syntactic S3 templates permitted by the registered grammar. A learned prediction is never itself an answer certificate.
falsifiable_mechanism.learned_component: TRAIN-only learn a bounded structural-shape-to-verified-compilation schedule over canonical word features, to select exact legal factor/elimination patterns and reduce proof-work. Scoring is not another contingent query-role priority model. Compiled schedules must validate against exact algebraic equivalence before use.
falsifiable_mechanism.boundary: Never merge states when future live bindings differ. Preserve globally consistent role identities across every use. On overflow, failed equivalence audit, ambiguity or unqualified source identity return UNKNOWN or exact public fallback, never guess.

fresh_source_contract.source_origin: fresh self-authored internal development only until independent source birth + global first-use certified
fresh_source_contract.privacy: candidate sees word, start, first public role pairs and paid queries only; no hidden operator or DEV truth
fresh_source_contract.adversarial_controls: unfamiliar words, role renaming, longer chains, inverses, composition, memorization shortcut probes

order: commit this hypothesis before origin of any T20 source or implementation
implement bounded exact quotient with equivalence tests
verify frozen TRAIN-only learning with no DEV influence
perform one GitHub-hosted Windows/Linux qualification after all code and source hashes are sealed
required_invariants: full process CPU/RSS includes source generation, training, compiled certificate, verifier, fallback, query accounting
verification.full_regression: single final integration regression only if subsequently eligible for integration, not for each intermediate qualification
verification.strict_benefit: strict reduction in total public queries OR demonstrably cheaper complete exact certification at identical or fewer public queries, with no complete CPU, peak RSS, or remote query-service cost regression; absolute learning gain must exceed fully trained and deterministic quotient controls
verification.resource_service_cost: instrument genuine per-query service when available; otherwise explicitly UNMEASURED and do not grant joint acceptance
verification.statistical_test: five whole-process repetitions per arm on Windows and Linux; predefined test families and seeds, no post-DEV tuning; independent reproduction required for generalization claims
